story.heroSubtitle: Transforming agricultural waste into eco-friendly solutions that reduce pollution and build a cleaner tomorrow.
story.crisisText: Every year, millions of tonnes of rice straw are burnt in the fields, choking India's air with toxic gases and particulate matter. In fact, parali (rice straw) burning contributes to a staggering 40% of Delhi's air pollution during peak seasons! This air pollution is choking India, costing the country a whopping 9% of its GDP every year. And if that's not enough, India's plastic waste problem is just as alarming, we're talking 9.3 million tonnes annually!
story.crisisText2: We believe there is a better way to treat the earth than this.
story.innovationSubtitle: How we transform agricultural residue into premium, food-safe tableware without a single chemical additive.
story.step1Desc: We source raw rice straw directly from farmers, preventing burning.
story.step2Desc: Straw is cleaned, crushed using mechanical energy.
story.step3Desc: High-pressure thermo-molding creates durable, water-resistant products.
story.step4Desc: Each piece is sterilized and checked for structural integrity.
story.step5Desc: After use, it returns to the earth as nutrient-rich compost in 90 days.
story.solutionText: We're on a mission to shake up the world with our eco-friendly disposable tableware, to make sustainability deliciously simple. And we're doing it with a bang! By turning India's abundant rice straw and husk into awesome, eco-friendly products, we're reducing waste, promoting sustainability, and making eco-friendly choices accessible to all.
story.solutionText2: Unlike paper, we don't cut trees. Unlike plastic, we don't last forever. Our products are designed for the circular economy, born from the soil, returning to the soil.
story.missionText: To make sustainability the easiest choice at every table. By transforming agri-waste into everyday tableware, we're fighting plastic pollution and parali burning, without a compromise.
story.visionText: A world where disposable doesn't mean damaging. Where every plate, every bowl, every meal is a quiet step toward a cleaner, greener planet.
story.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about our material and ethics.
story.faq1Q: Is there any chemical binder used in ZESTRAW?
story.faq1A: ZeStraw does not use synthetic or toxic chemical binders. Made using natural rice straw fibers and food-grade ingredients.
story.faq2A: Yes. ZeStraw tableware is designed to handle oily, dry, and wet foods without becoming soggy during normal use.

impactPage.whyResidueText: Rice straw is typically burned in North India, releasing millions of tons of particulate matter (PM2.5) into the atmosphere. We intercept this waste and mold it into tableware, providing farmers an alternative to burning while keeping carbon locked in a physical product.
